t: The Smith and Locke T bar pull handle in brushed nickel offers a stylish and durable solution for cabinet and cupboard upgrades. This premium quality handle features a corrosion-resistant finish, ensuring longevity in various environments. It is ideal for enhancing the aesthetic of kitchen units, bathroom vanity cabinets, or bedroom furniture. With a 178mm length and 96mm screw hole centres, installation is straightforward, and all necessary fixings are supplied for convenience.
